S26.02.needs: a signed-in account and a reply that makes an artifact

steps: Sign in and open the side panel chat.
Ask the chat for one HTML page or one code file and wait for the reply to finish.
Look at the artifact card under the reply: its name line should show the artifact's title.
Click Open on the card.
Compare the heading at the top of the artifact panel with the card name; both should show the same title.

labels.text: The preview could not start. Review the source or try again.

S26.35.needs: a signed-in account, and an artifact that fails to render (not something the tester can fully control)
S26.35.note: No retry control was found in apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/artifactPanel.ts. The failure is a status line, not a replacement error panel. The render-error case is at line 843 and the runtime-request case (AI or saved data) shows "AI and saved data are available once this app is published and opened by a signed-in viewer."
steps: Sign in and open the AGI side panel in Chrome.
Ask the assistant for a small web page (HTML) or another artifact that may fail to run. A deliberate script error is the reliable way to trigger it.
Click Open on the artifact card in the answer.
If the preview fails, read the status line under the panel header.
Click Code to see the source.
Compare with Expected: Expected asks for an error panel that explains the failure and offers source and retry. The code shows a status line plus the Preview/Code switch only, with no retry button.
S26.35.where: Side panel: an answer with an artifact card > Open > the panel's status line that reads "The preview could not start. Review the source or try again." > Code switch to see the source

labels.text: The live preview is not available right now, so the panel shows the source.

S26.36.needs: a signed-in account; a way to block or slow the preview (for example a network block) to see the failure path
S26.36.note: Timeouts are in apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/artifactPanel.ts lines 268-270 (3 s to connect, 15 s to load the document, 15 s to render). Only one loading line exists, not a separate state for libraries.
steps: Sign in and open the AGI side panel in Chrome.
Ask the assistant for an HTML artifact, then wait for the reply to finish.
Click Open on the artifact card.
Look right after it opens for the status line "Starting the preview…".
If the preview does not start, wait about 15 seconds. The panel should switch to the source with the note "The live preview is not available right now, so the panel shows the source."

Compare with Expected: Expected asks for a loading state while libraries load and a reported failure. The code shows the status line and the timeout note, and has no separate library-loading indicator.
S26.36.where: Side panel: an answer with an artifact card > Open > the panel's status line "Starting the preview…"; if the preview never starts, the note "The live preview is not available right now, so the panel shows the source."

labels.text: Run $TITLE$ in this chat on the web

S26.38.needs: a signed-in account and a chat saved to the account (the button is hidden for Temporary chat or for chats not synced to the account)
S26.38.note: No gallery, list or library view for artifacts was found in apps/extension, so the only path is from a chat reply. The tab URL is built in apps/extension/src/features/cloud-bridge/artifactsClient.ts (function at line 3) and used in apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts line 6073.
steps: Sign in and open the AGI side panel in Chrome, in a normal chat (not a Temporary chat).
Ask for an artifact so a card appears in the reply.
Click Open on the artifact card.
Hover the external-link icon button in the panel header to read its tooltip.
Click that button. A new browser tab should open for the same chat on the web.
Compare with Expected: Expected asks for a jump from a gallery, list or library. The extension has no such view; the jump exists only from the panel opened from a chat reply.
S26.38.where: Side panel: an answer with an artifact card > Open > the panel's external-link icon button (tooltip "Run $TITLE$ in this chat on the web")

S26.39.needs: a signed-in account and a reply long enough to stay in progress while the tester watches
S26.39.note: The live update path is in apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/artifactPanel.ts (canRunInSandbox returns false while streaming, around line 767). Timing of the visible update was not verified.
steps: Sign in and open the AGI side panel in Chrome.
Ask for a long artifact (for example a multi-section HTML page) and do not wait for the reply to finish.
While the reply is still writing, look for the card titled "Creating $TITLE$".
Click Open on that card and watch the source area for text appearing as the reply streams.

Compare with Expected: Expected asks for the view to update live as content arrives. The code re-renders the panel when the artifact changes, and the preview only runs after streaming ends, so the panel shows source while it updates.
S26.39.where: Side panel: an answer that is still writing > artifact card titled "Creating $TITLE$" > Open, then watch the source update
